name: teradata-vantage
description: Teradata Vantage toolkit for Claude Code. Bundles the open-source teradata-mcp-server 0.2.6 (MIT), installs it locally on request, or bridges to a server you already run. Adds 19 skills covering Teradata SQL, query, exploration, profiling, tuning, workload management, DBA health and recovery, loading, migration, pipelines, in-database analytics and AI, lineage, documentation, client development and NOS/Iceberg archiving and vector store, seven agents and four read-only workflows. Hooks guard reads, prompt before destructive writes and tools, and lint .sql files; two run only when a Teradata connection is configured (Teradata host-admin shell commands, and an optional pasted-credential warning that is off by default). Guards are mistake-prevention, not a security boundary. Ships a local health monitor that the health skill arms when a stored credential file exists; TERADATA_MONITORS=0 disables it. No telemetry; connects only to the Teradata system and MCP server you configure, and to PyPI/npm only when you explicitly install the local server. Community plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Teradata Corporation.

database_uri.title: Teradata DATABASE_URI
database_uri.description: Connection string for the bundled MCP server: teradata://user:password@host:1025/database (LOGMECH TD2 by default). Leave empty if you set the DATABASE_URI environment variable, use /teradata-vantage:setup connect, or bridge to an existing server via mcp_url.

mcp_url.title: Existing Teradata MCP server URL (optional)
mcp_url.description: If you already run teradata-mcp-server over streamable-http (for example http://127.0.0.1:8001/mcp/), set its URL here and the plugin bridges to it instead of starting a local server. Treated as sensitive because a URL can carry credentials in its userinfo; the plugin only ever reports its host part.

server_extras.title: Local server extras (optional)
server_extras.description: Comma-separated optional extras installed with the local server: tdvs (Teradata Enterprise Vector Store tools, ~170 MB more dependencies), bar (DSA backup tools). Leave empty for the core server.

enable_prompt_secret_guard.title: Warn when a connection string with a password is pasted into a prompt
enable_prompt_secret_guard.description: Off by default. When on, and only in sessions where a Teradata connection is configured, the plugin warns if a prompt contains a scheme://user:password@ URI so credentials do not land in the transcript.
